name: Text to Binary
summary: Encode plain text into 8-bit binary byte strings.
description: Convert UTF-8 text into binary representation with space-separated bytes. Quick encoder for learning, debugging, and encoding workflows.

faqs.question: How are bytes separated?
faqs.answer: Each UTF-8 byte is shown as 8 bits with a space between bytes.

faqs.question: Emoji and Unicode?
faqs.answer: Yes — multi-byte UTF-8 characters produce multiple binary groups.
